query: SELECT count() AS points,uniqExact(territory) AS territories,uniqExact(tuple(territory,settlement)) AS blocks,min(date) AS reference,min(loaded_at) AS first_loaded,max(loaded_at) AS last_loaded,groupBitXor(cityHash64(territory,territory_kind,settlement,sex,age_group,date,value,loaded_at)) AS checksum FROM v_rosstat_census_2020
SELECT territory_kind,uniqExact(territory) AS territories,count() AS points FROM v_rosstat_census_2020 GROUP BY territory_kind ORDER BY territory_kind
SELECT sex,value FROM v_rosstat_census_2020 WHERE territory_kind='RF' AND settlement='total' AND age_group='all' ORDER BY sex

SELECT count() AS groups,countIf(total!=parts OR n!=19) AS failed FROM (SELECT territory,settlement,sex,count() AS n,sumIf(value,age_group='all') AS total,sumIf(value,age_group!='all') AS parts FROM v_rosstat_census_2020 GROUP BY territory,settlement,sex)

SELECT count() AS groups,countIf(both!=male+female OR n!=3) AS failed FROM (SELECT territory,settlement,age_group,count() AS n,sumIf(value,sex='both') AS both,sumIf(value,sex='male') AS male,sumIf(value,sex='female') AS female FROM v_rosstat_census_2020 GROUP BY territory,settlement,age_group)

SELECT count() AS groups,countIf(rf!=districts) AS failed FROM (SELECT settlement,sex,age_group,sumIf(value,territory_kind='RF') AS rf,sumIf(value,territory_kind='FD') AS districts FROM v_rosstat_census_2020 WHERE territory_kind IN ('RF','FD') GROUP BY settlement,sex,age_group)

SELECT count() AS groups,countIf(total!=urban+rural OR n!=3) AS failed FROM (SELECT territory,sex,age_group,count() AS n,sumIf(value,settlement='total') AS total,sumIf(value,settlement='urban') AS urban,sumIf(value,settlement='rural') AS rural FROM v_rosstat_census_2020 WHERE territory NOT IN ('г. Москва','г. Санкт-Петербург') GROUP BY territory,sex,age_group)

SELECT count() AS groups,countIf(rf!=parts) AS failed FROM (SELECT sex,age_group,sumIf(value,territory_kind='RF') AS rf,sumIf(value,territory_kind IN ('subject','exclAO')) AS parts FROM v_rosstat_census_2020 WHERE settlement='total' OR (territory IN ('г. Москва','г. Санкт-Петербург') AND settlement='urban') GROUP BY sex,age_group)
SELECT territory,groupUniqArray(settlement) AS settlements FROM v_rosstat_census_2020 WHERE territory IN ('г. Москва','г. Санкт-Петербург') GROUP BY territory ORDER BY territory
SELECT source,series,unit,frequency FROM v_series_catalog WHERE source='rosstat_census_2020'
